meta.source: Federal Reserve, 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances (household net worth, 2023 dollars)
meta.note: Nationwide only — the SCF is not granular enough to break out by state or county, so net worth is always compared against the whole US here, never a specific place. Percentile anchors below the 10th percentile are floored to a small positive value because a meaningful share of US households report zero or negative net worth, which the log-log interpolation used for percentile lookup (lib/percentileTable.ts) cannot represent.
